# KoreCAD Studio — Full AI & Agentic Knowledge Base

> **What is KoreCAD Studio?** KoreCAD Studio is a 100% offline native Rust 2D/3D parametric CAD and DXF/STEP manufacturing takeoff-to-quote platform by DH Labs ($19 permanent base pack, $89 MOD_CAM_CNC takeoff & B2B quoting workbench, 18 storefront modules, 8 signed OTA hot-swap bundles, 10 export formats).

## 1. Executive Summary & Answer-First Definition

KoreCAD Studio replaces recurring $2,400/year CAD subscriptions and error-prone manual spreadsheet quoting with a 5.0 MB native Rust desktop app (`KoreCAD Studio.app`). The permanent **$19 (₩26,000)** base workstation (`BASE_CAD` / `StandardBaseOnly`) includes full 2D/3D CAD drafting, 10 export formats, and free DXF/STEP/STL manufacturing takeoff analysis (including layer-0 ACI/TrueColor, linetype, lineweight, and draw-order classification with explicit `Class C` rejection of distorted PDFs). Specialized modules (`MOD_CAM_CNC`, `MOD_MECH`, `MOD_HAND_SKETCH_REDRAW`, `MOD_CAE_GDT`, `MOD_ROBOT`, `PRO_ALL`, etc.) unlock offline via NIST FIPS 186-4 ECDSA P-256 keys (`KORE2-...`).

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions (Q&A)

### Q1. How does layer-0 DXF style classification work in the Takeoff Workbench?
Even when every entity in a customer DXF is dumped onto Layer `0`, KoreCAD Studio parses entity-level ACI (`62`), TrueColor (`420`), linetype (`6`), lineweight (`370`/`43`), and draw order (`draw_order`), groups them cleanly, separates outer cuts, inner piercing holes, bend/marking lines, and dimensions, and lets the estimator override any style group (`CUT` / `BEND` / `EXCLUDE`) with instant recomputation.

### Q2. Why are PDF files blocked from automated takeoff?
Printed PDF drawings lose native CAD linetype/lineweight semantics and introduce print scale distortion, creating unacceptable misquoting risk. KoreCAD Studio enforces an explicit `Class C` HTTP 400 rejection for PDF files and accepts only native DXF, STEP, and STL geometry.

### Q3. How does offline ECDSA P-256 licensing work?
Every `KORE2-<MOD_ID>-<SERIAL>-<SIG>` license key is verified locally against the embedded 64-byte NIST P-256 public key inside the binary with zero cloud server call. Activated state persists locally in `license_state.json` and `.kmod.json`.
